timeline.event: Casting by order of King Bodawpaya
Work completed (the Dagon University paper gives 1808–1810)

tiers.everyday: The Mingun Bell in Myanmar weighs about 90 tonnes and is one of the largest working bells in the world.
tiers.student: Myanmar Digital News gives casting on 29 April 1808 by King Badon (Bodawpaya), 90.52 tons or 55,555 viss; a Dagon University paper gives 90,718 kg, work 1808–1810, and notes the bell is uncracked.
